extensionName.description: Extension name shown in chrome://extensions and the Chrome Web Store listing.

extensionDescription.message: Bulk export from Strava's My Activities - GPX, TCX, original files, or one merged GPX. Runs locally in your browser.
extensionDescription.description: Short blurb shown in the Chrome Web Store listing. Stay under 132 characters.

selectAllVisible.description: Label for the checkbox that toggles all GPS-bearing rows on the current page.

downloadSelected.description: Primary action button. Disabled until at least one row is checked.

selectedCount.description: Status text showing how many rows are currently selected.

gpxButton.description: Label on the per-row download button. GPX is a file-format acronym - usually kept as-is in translations.

gpxButtonTitle.description: Tooltip on the per-row download button.

preparingDownloads.description: Brief status shown immediately after the user clicks Download selected.

downloadingProgress.description: Progress shown while a bulk download is in flight. COMPLETED is how many files are done; TOTAL is the full batch size.

buildingZip.description: Final stage of a multi-file bulk download - files are fetched, now JSZip is assembling them.

savedActivities.description: Terminal success message. Shown after a fully successful bulk run.

savedWithSkips.description: Terminal partial-success message. REASON is the first failure reason verbatim (e.g. 'HTTP 404'). REASON may stay in English.

downloadFailed.description: Terminal error message when an entire bulk run fails.

rowDownloadFailed.description: Alert shown when a single per-row GPX download fails.

koFiTitle.message: Buy Me a Coffee at ko-fi.com
koFiTitle.description: Hover tooltip on the Ko-fi support button in the toolbar. Keep 'Ko-fi' as a proper noun.

formatLabel.description: Label preceding the export-format dropdown in the toolbar.

formatTcx.description: Label for the TCX option in the format dropdown. TCX is a file-format acronym; usually kept as-is.

formatOriginal.description: Label for the 'original upload file' option in the dropdown (typically .fit from Garmin/Wahoo, sometimes .gpx/.tcx).

rowButtonTitle.description: Tooltip on the per-row download button. FORMAT is the localized name of the currently selected format (GPX/TCX/Original).

mergeSelected.description: Merge button label in GPX mode (separate-tracks setting): fetches every selected activity's GPX and saves one combined .gpx with one <trk> per activity.

mergingGpx.description: Status shown while the merge step is running (after all individual GPX files have been fetched).

savedMerged.description: Terminal success message after a merge run. COUNT is how many activities were successfully merged into the output file.

selectedCountWithHidden.description: Selection count when some selected activities are on other pages of the list (or filtered out by a search). COUNT is the total selected; HIDDEN is how many of those aren't currently shown.

clearSelection.description: Link-style button next to the selection count. Deselects every activity, including ones on other pages.

namesLabel.description: Label preceding the file-naming dropdown in the toolbar.

namesTooltip.message: How downloaded files are named. Sport folders only apply inside zips.
namesTooltip.description: Hover tooltip on the file-naming dropdown.

namesId.description: File-naming option: files are named strava_<activity id>.gpx (the default).

namesTitle.description: File-naming option: files are named <activity id>_<activity title>.gpx.

namesSport.description: File-naming option: like 'ID + title', but inside a zip each file goes into a folder named after its sport (Run/, Ride/, …).

exportCsv.description: Toolbar button that saves the selected activities' table columns (date, title, distance, …) as a CSV spreadsheet, without downloading any activity files.

savedCsv.description: Terminal success message after Export list (CSV).

cancel.description: Toolbar button shown while a bulk download or merge is running. Stops it without saving anything.

cancelled.description: Status shown after the user cancels a running bulk download or merge.

retryFailed.description: Button shown after a bulk download where some activities failed. Downloads only those again, as a new file.

showFailures.description: Expandable list under the toolbar after a partly failed run, naming each activity that failed and why.

rateLimited.message: Strava is limiting requests - retrying in $SECONDS$ s…
rateLimited.description: Progress status while Strava has asked us to slow down (HTTP 429). The download continues automatically after the wait.

csvActivityId.description: Column header in the exported CSV: the numeric Strava activity id.

csvActivityUrl.description: Column header in the exported CSV: link to the activity on strava.com.

csvFile.description: Column header in the CSV inside a bulk zip: the activity's file name within the zip.

exportTcx.description: Item added to the '…' menu on an activity page, after Strava's own 'Export GPX'. Used only when Strava's own item text doesn't contain 'GPX' (otherwise Strava's wording is reused with GPX swapped for TCX).

selectNew.description: Link-style toolbar button next to 'Select all visible'. Selects the rows on this page whose activity hasn't been exported in the current format yet.

selectNewTitle.message: Select the activities on this page you haven't exported as $FORMAT$ yet
selectNewTitle.description: Tooltip on 'Select new'. FORMAT is the current format label (GPX/TCX/Original).

exportedOn.description: Tooltip on the ✓ beside a row's download button. FORMAT is GPX/TCX/Original; DATE is a locale-formatted date.

moreOptions.description: Tooltip on the toolbar's '⋯' menu button.

historyImport.message: Mark activities from a CSV as exported ($FORMAT$)…
historyImport.description: '⋯' menu item. Opens a file picker for an activities.csv (from an earlier zip, or Strava's account archive) and marks its activities as already exported in the current FORMAT.

historyImported.description: Status after importing export history from a CSV.

historyImportEmpty.message: No activity IDs found in that file.
historyImportEmpty.description: Status when the chosen CSV has no numeric activity ids in its first column.

historyForget.description: '⋯' menu item that clears the record of which activities were exported (all formats). Needs a second click to confirm.

historyForgetConfirm.description: Label the 'Forget export history' item switches to after the first click; a second click within a few seconds confirms.

historyForgotten.description: Status after the export history has been forgotten.

mergeModeLabel.description: Label of the '⋯' menu dropdown choosing what a GPX merge produces: separate tracks, or one activity.

mergeModeTracks.description: GPX merge option: one track per activity in one file - for viewing a trip in a mapping tool. The default.

mergeModeSingle.description: GPX merge option: one track with each activity as a segment - for uploading back to Strava as a single activity.

joinSelected.description: Merge button label in GPX mode when the merge setting is 'One activity'.

joinTitle.message: One track with each activity as a segment, in time order - for uploading to Strava as a single activity. Delete the originals first, or Strava may reject it as a duplicate.
joinTitle.description: Tooltip on the merge button in 'One activity' mode.

mergeSelectedTcx.description: Merge button label in TCX mode.

mergeTcxTitle.message: One activity with each selected activity as a lap, in time order.
mergeTcxTitle.description: Tooltip on the merge button in TCX mode.

mergeNotOriginal.message: Merging works in GPX and TCX modes, not for Original files
mergeNotOriginal.description: Tooltip on the disabled merge button in Original mode (original uploads are mostly binary FIT files).

mergingTcx.description: Status while the TCX merge step runs (after all files have been fetched).

savedJoined.message: Saved one activity joined from $COUNT$ activities.
savedJoined.description: Success message after joining activities into one (GPX, 'One activity' mode).

savedMergedTcx.description: Success message after a TCX merge.

mergeOverlap.message: Can't join activities that overlap in time: $FIRST$ and $SECOND$
mergeOverlap.description: Error when activities being joined into one (GPX 'One activity' mode, or a TCX merge) overlap in time. FIRST and SECOND are activity titles.
